score_definitions.scientific_importance: Interest and mathematical/physical consequence assuming the claims hold.
score_definitions.overall_millennium: Overall research contribution on the public high-ceiling AIRR Millennium scale; not a school grade or correctness probability.
score_definitions.technical_quality: Precision, rigor, inspectability and presentation; not probability of truth.

score_bases.scientific_importance: Exact family-wide complete coefficients, genuine quantum-reference activation without entanglement, binary obstruction and fixed-dimensional measured realization. Specialized family; no minimal-reference or resource optimum, general-channel solution, capacity or robust experiment.
score_bases.overall_millennium: Excellent coherent and convincing contribution rather than a list of finite checks. Known methods and limited operational reach, with priority open, do not justify exceptional or field-shaping classification.
score_bases.technical_quality: Universal arguments, faithful support handling, endpoints, actual marginals, orientation and limits withstand inspection. Remaining reservations are bibliographic/evidence limits and minor clarity.

objections.statement: Exact priority remains unresolved; known tools, classical coefficients and generic non-contraction cannot be sold as new.
objections.basis: Primary passages checked; Lee–Makur2024 full formula/proof remains uninspected. Negative search is not a priority certificate.

objections.statement: Rare-event, conditioning and k-dependent measurement/marginal costs delimit operational relevance.
objections.status: manuscript scope satisfies limitation; preserve in public summaries
objections.basis: Condition ~4k2^k, exponentially rare q, decreasing trace distance, varying preparation/common marginal/effect; quantum input denominator. No fixed effect, spectral floor, optimal resources, capacity or robust experimental advantage.

objections.statement: State n>=3 at the start of Section5.1 before naming inactive eigenvalues.
objections.status: optional clarification; Theorem5.1 already restricts n>=3
objections.basis: For n=2 these modes have zero multiplicity; no main theorem relies on treating them as physical eigenvalues.

objections.statement: Shared context, dependent code/reports and unattested runtime cannot be represented as independent or blind review.
objections.basis: Prior involvement/context reused, late curation correction and historical1126 correction preserved. No automatic numerical AI penalty.

objections.statement: Keep a stable public link to exact supplement, complete reports and adverse results alongside the PDF.
objections.status: local packet verified; remote publication not checked or performed
objections.basis: Internal dossier identifiers alone do not establish public inspectability. This is not a gap in the self-contained proofs.
